Well, I got pulled over and I had 4 one mg klonopins on me, I freaked and ate them all. At first, I didn't seem to feel anything. After about an hour, I realized it seemed like it was only about ten minutes. The rest of the day, my very short term memory was a mess. I'd pass out for 5 minutes and come to again not knowing I had fallen asleep. Unlike xanax, it really didn't give me too much of a buzz. It made me feel, if anything, semi drunk. Needless to say, I don't remember much of the day. I find though if I am up and about their's no problem staying awake, and if I was at a bar, popped a few and after a few drinks I'd be totally trashed. Nice to get into EVERY ONCE IN A WHILE.
